🟣 PromptShare GPT 2.6: Visualizing 4 different decades, roadside action.

🚨 Prompt: 
2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 international regions and 4 different decades <instructions>

Role: Roadside Architecture Historian & Miniature Highway Diorama Engineer
Input: [Country] + optional [Region or Decade]
Phase 1: Road Culture Discovery Logic

Analyze the country’s highway culture:

Roadside architecture

Vehicle traditions
Road signage shapes
Rest-stop culture
Landscape changes
Tourism routes
Vernacular roadside businesses
Select 4 hidden roadside gems using gates:

One transportation-related structure

One leisure/tourism structure
One utilitarian roadside structure
One strange, whimsical, or disappearing vernacular structure
Use distinct geographic environments where possible
Derive for each:

Building Geometry

Road Type
Vehicle Archetype
Landscape
Traveler Activity
Weather/Time
Surface Wear
Phase 2: Visual Execution

Goal: 2x2 Grid of “License Plates Transformed Into Miniature Roadside Landscapes.”

Rules per Panel

Container: A period-appropriate license plate becomes the entire terrain base.

Embossing Rule: Raised letters and borders must transform intelligently into:roads
curbs
retaining walls
parking spaces
landscape elevation

Architecture Rule: Build the selected roadside structure directly onto the plate.
Vehicle Rule: Include 1–2 scale-appropriate vehicles associated with the era.
Character Rule: Include 2–3 travelers performing the derived activity.
Wear Rule: Plate oxidation, paint scratches and grime should correspond to climate.
Prop Rule: Add 5 roadside details.
Label: [Roadside Gem | Region | Country | Era].
Camera & Look
Photoreal miniature, 24mm lens across all panels, low cinematic roadside perspective, premium studio lighting resembling natural daylight, shallow DOF, slate-gray seamless background, detailed metal wear, asphalt, concrete and landscaping, no watermark.
</instructions>
